en:
Notorious bandit leader Muhammad Gwaska has displaced residents of Birnin Doki in the troubled Anka Local Government Area of Zamfara State after they resisted pressure to work at mining sites under his control.

The incident, which occurred on 15 October, saw dozens of villagers forced to walk about a 15-kilometre distance from Birnin Doki to the local government headquarters in Anka town. Since their arrival, local government authorities have shown them an abandoned and dilapidated structure that used to be a veterinary clinic to camp in.
